follow-up time: Within 2 weeks of last ultrasound scan
study type: Secondary analysis of a prospective observational trial
outcome: Accuracy of estimated fetal weight (EFW) by ultrasound
cohort: Pregnant women with singleton pregnancies and EFW in less than the tenth centile
finding: While ultrasound examination is reliable for assessing fetal weight in overweight women with FGR, maternal obesity has a significant adverse effect on perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Overweight and obese women were more likely to deliver by cesarean section and at earlier gestational ages compared to women with a normal BMI.
birth_weight: EFW in less than the tenth centile
